abilities.name: Musou Isshin
abilities.description: While in the Musou Isshin state, the Raiden Shogun wields her tachi in battle. Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks are infused with Electro DMG (cannot be overridden) and count as Elemental Burst DMG.
_curatorNotes: [A7] Stored plunge frames are the low-plunge (Xianyun-assisted) values. Unused high-plunge: hitmark 51f (48+3), swap 61. ⚠️ HISTORICAL — the field this describes no longer exists in that form; see the ↻ below.

↻ 2026-08-18 (stale since the L4b frame-shape migration, 1c37968): the plunge maps are now TWO fields and the HIGH plunge is the default. `plungeFrames` is the HIGH plunge and is what the bare `P` and `hP` tokens resolve; `lowPlungeFrames` is `lP` ONLY (src/lib/sim/run.ts ~:1286, `isLowPlunge ? (lowPlungeFrames ?? plungeFrames) : plungeFrames`). So the map the A7 note called "unused" is the authored default, and the map it called "stored" is now the `lP`-only fallback. ⛔ Any plunge note in this corpus predating L4b is describing a different field — re-read it against the two names before trusting it.

Both maps re-verified against gcsim 2026-08-18, internal/characters/raiden/plunge.go — the STANCE (BurstKey active) variants, i.e. `highPlungeFramesB`/`lowPlungeFramesB` in that file's init(), not the grounded pair used by abilities[0] Origin. plungeFrames = highPlungeFramesB: InitAbilSlice(88), Attack 60, Skill 60, Burst 60, Dash 83, Jump 81, Swap 61 — matches. lowPlungeFrames = lowPlungeFramesB: InitAbilSlice(85), 58/59/59/78/81, Swap 60 — matches. Hitmarks are `highPlungeHitmarkB = 48 + 3 = 51` and `lowPlungeHitmarkB = 46 + 3 = 49` (plunge.go:32-34). Neither map authors a `hit` field and neither should: `hit` is `InitNormalCancelSlice`'s hitmark tier and gcsim builds both plunges with `InitAbilSlice`, which has no such tier.

⚠️ The ability caveat's Xianyun claim survives the field split and covers BOTH maps: gcsim's `LowPlungeAttack` AND `HighPlungeAttack` (plunge.go:88-98, :181-191) return "can only be used while airborne" for anything other than `player.AirborneXianyun`, so switching the default from low to high did not make an unassisted plunge legal here.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The plunge block drawn inside her burst stance — both that it draws at all and how wide it is. gcsim refuses both HighPlungeAttack and LowPlungeAttack here for anything other than AirborneXianyun, so a `P` written inside Musou Isshin renders a bar for an action the game will not let you take, at frames measured for the assisted case. Re-verified against gcsim 2026-08-18 and explicitly noted as surviving the L4b high/low field split. Category: approximation-disclosure.

abilities.name: Transcendence: Baleful Omen

_curatorNotes: Coordinated attack, authored 2026-08-18. gcsim raiden/skill.go:104 subscribes eyeOnDamage to event.OnEnemyDamage: any damaging hit from a character carrying the Eye buff (every party member gets it) fires a coordinated strike 5 frames later — Electro, Durability 25, ICDTagElementalArt/ICDGroupDefault — behind a 54f (0.9s) party-wide ICD. Talent row 'Coordinated ATK DMG' = 75.6% ATK at level 10.

⚓ THE STREAM IS ANY DAMAGE THE OPPONENT TAKES, SUMMON DAMAGE INCLUDED (⚓ Nate 2026-08-18, the round's one open design question). The in-game condition is that the opponent took DMG, so a fully-shielded enemy does not proc it — and we do not model a shielded enemy, so it reduces to every damage-dealing hit. `source: 'team'` with no abilityType filter is that.

icdGate ABSENT = the standard window, gcsim's Default group here; at a 0.9s proc cooldown Electro lands on every third strike. ⚠️ gcsim also skips EC, Burning and Hydro-swirl damage, which are sourced to the TARGET rather than to a character — we emit no hits for reaction damage at all, so the exclusion is free.
A6 rigor 2026-07-12: burst DMG bonus per-energy corrected ≈0.35% → ≈0.30% (T10) (gcsim skillBurstBonus[9]=0.003; sidecar 0.30% Per Energy)
[A7] Per-member value = mult × that member's burst energy cost; ≈0.30% per energy at T10 per the existing A6 rigor note.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The value is authored as `{type:'unknown', description:'≈0.30% per energy cost (T10)'}`, and `formatBuffDisplayValue` prints that description verbatim on the bar — so the bar ALREADY reads '≈0.30% per energy cost (T10)'. The caveat spends a third of the column restating what the bar says about itself. Nothing on screen is wrong or approximate: the 25s window is right, and the per-member formula is the honest label. Category: working-behavior.
abilities.description:
The Raiden Shogun unveils a shard of her Euthymia, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents, and granting nearby party members the Eye of Stormy Judgment.

Eye of Stormy Judgment
·When characters with this buff attack and deal DMG to opponents, the Eye will unleash a coordinated attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG at the opponent's position. One coordinated attack every 0.9s per party.
·Characters who gain the Eye of Stormy Judgment will have their Elemental Burst DMG increased based on the Energy Cost of their Elemental Burst during the Eye's 25s duration.

abilities.name: Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu
abilities.description:
Gathering truths unnumbered and wishes uncounted, the Raiden Shogun unleashes the Musou no Hitotachi and deals AoE Electro DMG, using Musou Isshin in combat for a certain duration afterward. The DMG dealt by Musou no Hitotachi and Musou Isshin attacks is increased based on Chakra Desiderata Resolve stacks consumed.

Musou Isshin
While in this state, the Raiden Shogun wields her tachi in battle. Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks are infused with Electro DMG (cannot be overridden) and count as Elemental Burst DMG.

Chakra Desiderata
When nearby party members (excluding Raiden) use their Elemental Bursts, the Raiden Shogun builds Resolve stacks based on the Energy Cost of those Bursts (max 60 stacks). Resolve stacks increase the DMG of the initial Musou no Hitotachi and Musou Isshin hits.
_curatorNotes: ↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Resolve is a resource counter and its payoff is a DMG bonus — the tool has no resource readout anywhere, and damage magnitude is frozen out of scope by the constitution. Nothing about the Q bar, its width, its cooldown tail or any marker changes with Resolve, so no player looking at the chart is confused by its absence. Category: invisible-omission.

passives.name: Wishes Unnumbered
passives.description: When nearby party members gain Elemental Orbs or Particles, Chakra Desiderata gains 2 Resolve stacks. This effect can occur once every 3s.

passives.name: Enlightened One
passives.description:
Each 1% above 100% Energy Recharge that the Raiden Shogun possesses grants her:
·0.6% greater Energy restoration from Musou Isshin
·0.4% Electro DMG Bonus.
_curatorNotes: AUTHORED 2026-08-31: was a `type: "unknown"` placeholder ("0.4% per 1% ER above 100%") because neither half of the shape existed — `energyRecharge` was not a Stat and `BuffValue.scaling` had no `offset`. Both landed this session, so the real value is now expressible: 0.4 percentage points of Electro DMG Bonus per 1% ER above 100. ⛔ NO cap — the kit states none (unlike Alyosha's A2, which caps at 70%). ⚠️ The OTHER half of this passive (+0.6% Energy restoration from Musou Isshin per 1% ER) stays unauthored: it scales an energy-restoration mechanic, not a Stat, and we model no such buff.

⚠️ CORRECTION 2026-08-31, same session: first authored `ratio: 0.4`, wrong by 100×. "0.4% Electro DMG per 1% ER above 100%" is 40% OF the excess ER, so ratio is 40. ⚓ ratio is VALUE PER 100 STAT UNITS (BuffValue JSDoc: contribution = (ratio/100) × stat), which is why a "per 1% ER" kit reads as ratio 40, not 0.4. Cross-check: Mona's "20% of her Energy Recharge rate" is ratio 20; at ER 200 Raiden gains (40/100) × (200−100) = 40% Electro DMG.

constellations.name: Ominous Inscription
constellations.description: Chakra Desiderata will gather Resolve even faster. When Electro characters use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 80%. When characters of other Elemental Types use their Elemental Bursts, the Resolve gained is increased by 20%.

constellations.name: Wishbearer
constellations.description:
While in the Musou Isshin state applied by Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, attacks by the Raiden Shogun that are considered part of her Elemental Burst will decrease all nearby party members' (not including the Raiden Shogun herself) Elemental Burst CD by 1s when they hit opponents.
This effect can trigger once every 1s and can trigger a total of 5 times during Musou Isshin's duration.
_curatorNotes: ↻ AUTHORED 2026-09-18 (cooldown-reduction round — docs/cooldown-reduction-round.md §5). −1s to every OTHER party member's burst cooldown per Musou Isshin Normal/Charged Attack that hits (gcsim cons.go c6, called from attack.go:152 and charge.go:104), once per 1s (c6ICD), 5 per burst (c6Count, zeroed at burst cast — burst.go:37). `inStance` is her burst stance (she has no skill stance), `procCooldown: 1`, `procCap: 5 per stance`. The reduction lands on a teammate's RUNNING burst clock only (gcsim's early return), so a burst cast after her stance sees nothing — order the rotation as played. The caveat "Not modeled: the C6 CD reduction" is retired.
